provenance.capture: Core requests reconstructed exactly from probe.py. Spot generator was not retained: requests reconstructed from case names and checked against archived reports. Where the reconstructed canonical hash differs, the original and replacement hashes are listed below; all other report fields match. Every stored expected Rust report was verified by replaying its stored request against the unchanged audit algorithm/codec sources. Tests consume only this JSON, with no Rust runtime or market data dependency.
provenance.harness: The five Rust algorithm/codec source files above match PR23 byte-for-byte; the scratch lib.rs and stdin main.rs only expose the VIX modules.

go_identity_allowances.code_sha256: SHA-256 of embedded current Go options sources; not Rust source identity.
go_identity_allowances.transport_sha256: SHA-256 of exact incoming bytes, including whitespace; demo transport hashes scenario bytes.
go_identity_allowances.request_json: Go pretty-printed typed request; canonical report/input_sha256 must survive roundtrip.
go_identity_allowances.errors: Rust PascalCase enum names map explicitly to Go SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE codes; no semantic error mismatch allowed.
go_identity_allowances.report: No report fields or hashes are ignored. The sole exception is weekly plus prefix, recorded per case.
